title: Jubilant Springy German Kabanos Skewers
description: A festive German dish featuring Polish kabanos, marinated in a Mediterranean-friendly mix of flavors, perfect for spring celebrations. This bitter and springy dish is sure to delight your taste buds.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the sliced kabanos to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated kabanos, pineapple chunks, and red onion slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the kabanos are slightly charred and cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary sprigs if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a simple salad.
